newsitem.title: UK: Cadbury shares lose fizz on Coke offer.
newsitem.headline: Cadbury shares lose fizz on Coke offer.

text.p: Shares in Cadbury Schweppes Plc fell 10p to 531-1/2p on Tuesday after press reports said Coca Cola Co was seeking to banish soft drinks produced by Dr Pepper/Seven Up Inc from thousands of McDonald's Corp restaurants.
Dr Pepper/Seven Up is a Cadbury subsidiary.
"This deal would be a real coup for Coke and certainly dent Dr Pepper's U.S. business," one analyst who wished to remain anonymous said.

In exchange for selling only Coca-Cola products, Coke has offered McDonald's franchisees between 200 and 600 free gallons of soda syrup for each restaurant -- enough to make between 30,000 and 90,0000 drinks per unit, the New York Times newspaper said.
